faq.q: Is this a drag-and-drop Kanban board with columns?
faq.a: Despite the name, it's a single list-based task manager, not column-based. Tasks have priority (Low/Medium/High/Urgent), optional due date, tags, notes, and subtasks, and you reorder them by dragging (mouse or touch) when 'Sort: Manual' is selected. You filter by smart views like Today, Tomorrow, This Week, Overdue, No Date, and Completed instead of moving cards between To Do / Doing / Done columns.

Yes. In a task's edit modal you can set Recurring to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly; Weekly lets you tick specific weekdays. When you complete a recurring task, the tool automatically spawns a fresh copy with the next due date calculated from the recurrence, copying over the notes, priority, tags, and reset subtasks.

faq.q: What do the stats and chart show?
faq.a: A stats grid shows tasks completed today, completed this week, your overall completion rate as a percentage, and a day streak counter based on consecutive days with at least one completion. Below it, a 7-day bar chart plots how many tasks you finished each of the last seven days. Completions are tracked by date in a history object.

faq.q: How do I back up or move my tasks?
faq.a: Several export options: Export JSON (full backup of all lists, re-importable), plain Text, Markdown checklist, Copy Checklist (copies the currently filtered on-screen view), and a Backup ZIP containing the JSON, a human-readable checklist.txt, a tasks.csv for spreadsheets, and a README. Only the JSON can be re-imported, via the Import button or by dragging it onto the drop zone. Everything is stored locally under the key fth_todo_v2.
